title: Zscaler SIMs and eSIMs: inventory fields, status versus connection, and the Inventory state

prose.text: The SIMs page is the inventory of every Zscaler SIM provisioned to the organization.

prose.label: Actions.
prose.text: {{bulk-actions}} {{per-sim-edits}} The API equivalents (SIM search, lock and status update) are in [[zscaler-cellular.api.wire-notes]].

checks.do: Whether the SIM is Inactive (status) or Offline (connection): they are separate fields.
For an eSIM showing an unexpected connection state after being returned to inventory, whether its details were opened to refresh it.

sim-kinds.statement: Zscaler SIMs include physical SIMs and eSIMs, and are viewed and managed in the Zscaler Admin Console.

quotes: A Zscaler SIM—both physical SIMs and eSIMs—serves as the gateway for a cellular-connected device to access the Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE).
You can view essential details and statuses, and manage Zscaler SIMs provisioned to your organization, in the Zscaler Admin Console.

inventory-columns.statement: The SIMs page lists, per SIM, ICCID, EID (for eSIMs), IMEI, IMSI, MSISDN, IP address, form factor, device manufacturer, model and type, operating system, usage, status, country, tags and connection.

quotes: ICCID: The Integrated Circuit Card Identifier is a globally unique identifier assigned to each SIM.
EID: The Embedded Identity Document for the eSIM.
IMEI: The International Mobile Equipment Identity is a unique identifier for the mobile device associated with the SIM.
IMSI: The International Mobile Subscriber Identity is a unique number assigned to each mobile subscriber.
MSISDN: The Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number is the associated mobile number of the SIM, if applicable.
IP Address: The IP address assigned to the device using the SIM
Form Factor: The type of SIM, indicating whether it is a physical SIM or an eSIM.
Device Manufacturer: The name of the company that produces the device associated with the SIM.
Device Model: The full official identifier of the type of device associated with the SIM.
Device Type: The category of the device associated with the SIM (e.g., router, modem, and IoT gateway).
Operating System: The operating system running on the device associated with the SIM.
Usage: The amount of data consumed during the session (the duration between the start of the network connection and its termination), displayed in MB or GB.
Status: The operational state of the SIM, either Active (available for use) or Inactive (not in use).
Country: The country where the SIM is located.
Tags: The tags associated with the SIM.
Connection: The connectivity state of the SIM.

status-vs-connection.statement: Status and connection are separate: status is Active (available for use) or Inactive (not in use), while connection is Online, Offline or Inventory (ready for assignment or awaiting profile registration; eSIMs only).

quotes: Status: The operational state of the SIM, either Active (available for use) or Inactive (not in use).
Online: The SIM is connected to the network.
Offline: The SIM is disconnected from the network.
Inventory: The SIM is ready for assignment, or if already assigned, awaiting profile registration on a device. This option applies only to eSIMs.

inventory-state.statement: Inventory applies only to eSIMs and means the eSIM is ready for assignment, or assigned and awaiting profile registration on a device.

quotes: Inventory: The SIM is ready for assignment, or if already assigned, awaiting profile registration on a device. This option applies only to eSIMs.

stale-connection.statement: When an eSIM assigned to a user is released back to inventory, its connection state may not update on the SIMs page; viewing the eSIM's details refreshes it.

quotes: If an eSIM was originally assigned to a user and then released back to the inventory, the connection state might not be updated on the SIMs page. You can refresh the connection state by viewing the eSIM details.

bulk-actions.statement: Status or IMEI can be updated for several selected SIMs at once, and the current view (with its filters) can be downloaded as CSV; the Total Usage figure covers only SIMs matching the applied filters.

quotes: Update SIM Status or IMEI for multiple SIMs. This option is displayed only when a SIM is selected.
Download the list of all SIMs and their details as a CSV file for the current view.
If filters are applied, the Total Usage field shows only the data across the SIMs that match the applied filters.

per-sim-edits.statement: A single SIM's status, IMEI and tags can be edited, and its detailed information viewed.

quotes: Edit status, update the IMEI, or update tags for a particular SIM.
View detailed information for each SIM.
